{{Quote|It has come to the Empire's attention that dissident elements engaging in a tawdry and potentially dangerous seasonal event are planning to infect Imperial space with their insipid notions.|Extract from Imperial Edict GR-1NC4|<ref name="Holonet">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20131216|text=IMPERIAL EDICT GR-1NC4}}</ref>}}
The '''Life Day Revelers''' were a group of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebrants active during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3638 BBY]], they tried to promote their holiday in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the authorities of which regarded them as subversive nonconformists. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], they were accidentally authorized to peddle their goods and display their cheerful demeanor on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] maintainedby the Empire, which prompted the issuing of the [[Imperial Edict GR-1NC4]], a legal text that deemed all trade with the Life Day Revelers illicit.<ref name="Holonet" />
